detail.title: Intex Echo Wired In-Ear Earphones with Mic
detail.overview: powerful sound and all-day comfort with the Intex Echo Wired In-Ear Earphones. Designed for music lovers, these earphones deliver deep bass and crystal-clear audio for an immersive listening experience. The ergonomic in-ear design ensures a secure and comfortable fit, while the built-in microphone allows seamless calling on the go. With a durable, tangle-free cable and universal 3.5mm compatibility, these earphones are perfect for daily use—whether you're commuting, working, or relaxing.
